legend.0: CONVERSATIONAL: Casual conversation, no distress. Mild or momentary reactions to media/events ("that movie made me sad") are CONVERSATIONAL.
legend.1: CONCERN: Anxiety, worry, stress, sadness, unhappiness, shame, loneliness, low self-worth, or emotional pain needing support
legend.2: MEDIUM: Panic attack, breakdown, severe emotional distress, violent thoughts about self or others
legend.3: HIGH: Suicidal ideation, self-harm, severe crisis requiring immediate intervention
